content.short: Parallel Protocol is an over-collateralized stablecoin protocol minting against deposited assets.
content.description: Parallel Protocol issues over-collateralised stablecoins against deposited assets, with deployments spanning several networks including Hyperliquid. Its notable feature is issuing non-dollar denominations as well, which matters for users whose liabilities are not in dollars and who currently carry currency risk just by holding stablecoins.
content.meta: Over-collateralized stablecoins including non-dollar denominations, minted against deposits.
